title: A benchmark's answer key
description: benchmark/keys/<owner>/<name>.json: an answer key the benchmark scores against. Every site is a file and a line. A key is for a repository on GitHub at one commit, or for a corpus kept in this repository: Cryben (arXiv:2608.04857), whose key is written from its ground truth by benchmark/cryben.ts and whose files are in benchmark/cryben/corpus.

commit.description: The commit of the repository on GitHub the key is for; or, for a corpus kept in this repository, the SHA-1 over its files.

corpus.description: For a key over a corpus kept in this repository: the folder its files are in.

source.description: The published benchmark the key comes from.

by.description: Where the verdict comes from: the benchmark's own ground truth (cryben), consensus, review:<github login>, judge:<model>, or check (failed verification).

claimedBy.description: Submission ids that reported the site.

rejectedBy.description: Submission ids that looked and said no.

firstClaim.description: The id of the earliest CBOM to report it.

foundBy.description: The GitHub account that submitted that CBOM: who found it.
